Effective Finish — Quiet Chronology, Phased

An agent (Claude Code is the motivating case) can mark its turn waiting while background sub-agents still emit bytes. Raw waiting in finishedIds is then a premature finish — chime and host-tab mark before the work actually stopped. The fix is not a second byte-tap state machine in padi. It is:

  1. kaval reports meaningful PTY output (resize repaints excluded at the source),
  2. padi + client cut over live-dots onto that fact in one PR (no dual path),
  3. padi pure-folds finish from the same edge + waiting episode stamps.

Work items use the EF track prefix (new; no Atlas collisions). #1938 closed without merge — design kept, big-bang delivery discarded. This note is the plan of record (#1944). EF1 shipped (#1945): activity is a single host-side fact. Master still uses raw-waiting for finishedIds until EF2.

The problem

Symptom Cause
Premature “finished” finishedIds = raw agent waiting packages/padi/src/urgency.ts
Visit finished tile → re-chime First #1938 design made finish byte-reactive; client resize mute did not travel to padi taps
Sticky “all terminals live” #1938 Phase D stored a Solid reconcile proxy as prev; removals never applied

Attention already has one model (docs/atlas/src/content/atlas/agent-attention.mdx / #1931). This note only makes the finished half of that model honest — and, as a prerequisite, makes activity a single source of truth.

End state

Facts (one writer each)

Fact Writer Clock
Meaningful output edge { id } kaval onData funnel (not resize-muted burst) n/a on the wire
lastMeaningfulArrivalAt[id] folding padi, on edge arrival padi wall clock
enteredWaitingAt[id] padi, on agent-bucket enter waiting padi wall clock

Never ship kaval absolute timestamps for the fold — the attention model is recency-free (“nothing cross-host ever compares two hosts’ clocks”). Edge on the wire; stamp at the folder.

Pure finish fold

finished(id) =
  active ∧ bucket = waiting
  ∧ enteredWaitingAt ≠ null
  ∧ now − max(enteredWaitingAt, lastMeaningfulArrivalAt ?? enteredWaitingAt)
      ≥ EFFECTIVE_FINISH_QUIET_MS   // ~5s
  • ASKING (awaiting_user) stays ungated — blocking, fires at once.
  • Default-excluded — missing/late stamps only delay a finish.
  • Deadline wake for the “stayed quiet” non-event (timer at next crossing).
  • No settle set, no attach observer, no six parallel maps.

Live activity (same edge, short window)

  • Short window: TERMINAL_IDLE_AFTER_MS (~1s).
  • padi activity stream = live id set; client mirrors it for dock/title dots.
  • Client must copy frames to plain arrays before set-diff (prev = [...frame]), never hold the store proxy from reconcile.
  • No dual path: after EF1, no padi byte taps for activity, no client noteOutput / resize-suppress hack.

What kaval does not own

Quiet windows (5s finish vs 1s live-dot) stay consumer policy. Kaval owns which bursts count (resize-aware filter + throttle), not a single live/quiet boolean with one internal timer.

Why not “edge only, consumers later”?

Shipping a kaval stream with nothing product-facing on it leaves the old mechanism in place (padi taps, client attach counters). That is a half-baked dual path: untestable end-to-end, two truths for “is live,” and a second PR tax to finish the cutover. EF1 is one volatility axis — activity ownership — cut over completely. Finish is a different axis (attention policy) and stays EF2.

Phase tree

Strict dependency: EF0 → EF1 → EF2 → EF3. Each remaining box is one PR, green alone, revertible alone. EF0 and EF1 are complete.

EF2 — pure finish fold (finish honesty)

EF2· pure finish fold▶ do next
needs ← EF1blocks → EF3

ELI15

When the agent says “I’m done,” wait until the terminal has been actually quiet for a few seconds before the “finished” ping. Background work still typing keeps you waiting. Reuses the doorbell from EF1 — no new wiretaps.

Ship Do not
Subscribe to kaval activity (or shared padi fan-out of it); stamp arrival on padi clock Byte-tap waiting terminals
Stamp enteredWaitingAt on agent-bucket edge (+ boot seed if needed) Six-set / attach / gen-fence machine
Pure fold into urgency.finishedIds + deadline wake Re-open activity cutover (EF1 already done)
Unit: enter waiting + quiet → finish; edge resets window; episode restamp
Regression: resize-class edge does not re-open finish

Prefer stamps + fold next to urgency / commit — a thin module is fine; a second “FinishGate” product name is not required if a pure function + deadline source suffices.

Done when: background-subagent case does not chime early; visit-finished regression is fenced (injection/unit minimum; e2e may wait for EF3).

Anti-patterns

Do not Why
Dead kaval wire + old padi/client paths left in place Half-baked dual mechanism; untestable; second PR tax
One PR = activity cutover and finish fold Two volatilities; #1938 failure mode (bugs mask each other)
Quiet boolean with one window in kaval Complects producer with consumer policy
Absolute kaval time for the fold Breaks recency-free / invites cross-host compare
Delete client activity tests in the mirror cutover Sticky-live shipped silent
Ship EF2 without a visit/re-open fence Known regression class
Call the pure fold a “gate v2” and claim deletion Reviewers cannot tell the machine is gone

Minimal hotfix (only if on fire)

If premature finish must land before EF1–EF2: a sticky-per-waiting-episode finished membership (bytes cannot eject until leave-waiting) weakens “resume after long pause” and is not the plan of record — stopgap only, then still run EF1→EF2.

Relation to attention

Agent Attention owns the rules (fire once, seen, host-tab, dock). This note owns (1) one activity fact end-to-end and (2) the truth of finished before those rules run. After EF1, live dots tell the truth about output; after EF2, finishedIds means effective quiet.
